name: Alene of Riverspan
description: A resident of Riverspan whose ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship.

description_citations.text: Bloomburrow Commander: card flavor text (Bloomburrow Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian portal ship was brought down by Riverspan's ancestors, who built their town on its hull.
timeline.quote: Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull.
